description: This file defines the API and data structures for log link management in Zephyr OS, including creation, activation, querying, and message enqueue functions for log links.

methods.name: log_link_initiate
methods.description: Initiates a log link asynchronously, returning immediately with success or error code.

methods.name: log_link_activate
methods.description: Completes the activation of a log link, preparing it for use.

methods.name: log_link_is_active
methods.description: Checks if the log link is fully activated.

methods.name: log_link_domains_count
methods.description: Returns the number of domains in the log link.

methods.name: log_link_sources_count
methods.description: Returns the number of sources in a specified domain.

methods.name: log_link_get_domain_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a specified domain.

methods.name: log_link_get_source_name
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a specified source within a domain.

methods.name: log_link_get_levels
methods.description: Gets the compile-time and runtime log levels for a source.

methods.name: log_link_set_runtime_level
methods.description: Sets the runtime log level for a source.

methods.name: z_log_msg_enqueue
methods.description: Enqueues an external log message into the log link processing queue.
